changelog:
1.49.0-dev.5
🐛 Bug Fixes
• Temporarily change expired PoToken check to log only instead of a user dialog
• YouTube - Miniplayer: Minimal miniplayer is covered by the keyboard before 21.29
• YouTube - Theme: Custom background colors are not applied with 21.43

1.49.0-dev.4
🐛 Bug Fixes
• YouTube - Ambient mode: Ambient mode is not disabled with 21.43
• YouTube - Feed card layout: Shorts shelves change width and corners when only a last row with one Short is in the list
• YouTube - Hide status bar: Status bar scroll color and translucent navigation bar do not follow the hidden status bar before the edge to edge flag is read
• YouTube - Miniplayer: "Disable resuming miniplayer" may not work with latest experimental app target
• YouTube: Fingerprints are not found on some targets between 21.04 and 21.35

1.49.0-dev.3
🐛 Bug Fixes
• YouTube: 21.43 navigation tabs cannot be hidden

1.49.0-dev.2
🐛 Bug Fixes
• YouTube - Disable continue watching prompt: Prompt can still appear during playback
• YouTube - Feed card layout: Horizontal shelves lose the card background when their header is scrolled out of the list
• YouTube - Feed card layout: Videos of the horizontal shelves are cut by the left edge of the card
• YouTube - Hide status bar: Status bar covers the top bar or leaves an empty bar above it
• YouTube - Navigation bar: Empty band below the reply bar of the comment replies
• YouTube - Navigation bar: No connection and back online bars are covered by the system navigation buttons
• YouTube - Navigation bar: System navigation buttons cannot be seen in the Shorts player with the light theme
• YouTube - Navigation buttons: Create button is not hidden with the new navigation bar layout
• YouTube - Playback speed: Channel speed whitelist does not work for Shorts
• YouTube - Shorts autoplay: Overlay is out of place when going back to a Short that advanced with the comments open
• YouTube: Morphe flyout menu items are missing in the new popup menu

🚀 Updated App Support
• YouTube: Add experimental support for 21.43.523

1.49.0-dev.1
✨ New Features
• YouTube - Navigation bar: Add "Disable toolbar navigation tabs" setting
• YouTube: Add Search comments patch

🐛 Bug Fixes
• YouTube - Hide status bar: Video player is moved below the display cutout in portrait
• YouTube - Navigation bar: Translucent navigation bar is not shown without the edge to edge layout
• YouTube: Miniplayer covered by the keyboard and empty band above the navigation bar
• YouTube: Morphe flyout menu items are missing on tablets

🚀 Updated App Support
• YouTube: Add support for 21.23.492
